title: Fix the Wrong Array Size Inside a Function
description: The program should count the elements of an array using sizeof, both at the top level and inside a function.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 5, the number of elements in the array.
actualProblem: When an array is passed to a function, it decays into a plain pointer. Inside printCount, sizeof(arr) measures the size of a pointer (commonly 8 bytes), not the original array, so the calculation gives the wrong count.
explanation: sizeof only knows the true size of an array within the scope where it was actually declared as an array. Once passed to a function it's just a pointer, so the array's length must be passed in separately as an extra parameter.
